Serie A plays a full midweek round from Tuesday to Thursday, with leaders Inter at Venezia, Juventus at Genoa and Milan hosting Bologna. Here are the odds on all 10 games at US sportsbooks, the best price on each result and total, and the five bets that stand out. Matchweek 9 comes only days after the weekend round, and that tends to favor the deeper squads at the top of the table. Inter and Lazio are level on 22 points after eight games, with Roma and Milan on 18. The clearest value of the week is not with the leaders, though: it is Lazio at plus money in Sassuolo and Atalanta as the underdog in Florence. Standings and stats run through Matchweek 8. Prices were compared at FanDuel, DraftKings, BetRivers and LetsBetMD, with three-way moneylines (win, draw, win). For more books, see the list of US sportsbooks . Sassuolo Vs Lazio Tuesday, Oct. 27, 1:30 p.m. ET, Mapei Stadium Lazio are 7-1-0 and have conceded only five goals, the fewest in the league. They won 3-0 at Juventus and then beat Parma 2-1. Sassuolo are 2-2-4, have conceded 16 and lost 2-0 at Como on Saturday. A side with this defensive record should not be +108 to +120 against a team in the bottom half. Sassuolo have scored 12 goals, so they are not without threat, but Lazio's form makes them the clear pick. LetsBetMD has the best price. The pick: Lazio to win at +120 at LetsBetMD. Statistics 5 Goals Conceded: Fewest In Serie A No defense in the league has been harder to break down than Lazio's. Statistics 3-0: Lazio's Win At Juventus Lazio followed that result with a 2-1 win over Parma. Statistics 16 Goals Conceded By Sassuolo Sassuolo are 2-2-4 and lost 2-0 at Como on Saturday. Statistics Torino Vs Como Tuesday, Oct. 27, 3:45 p.m. ET, Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino Como are fifth with 17 points after a 3-1 win at Fiorentina and a 2-0 home win over Sassuolo, and Anastasios Douvikas has five league goals. Torino have won their last two, 3-0 at Parma and 3-2 at home to Monza, and are on 13 points. Torino's recent wins came against two of the weaker sides in the league. Como have conceded only seven goals and are the more complete team. The price is short, but this is the right side. The pick: Como to win at -135 at BetRivers. Cagliari have scored only six times in eight games and have lost their last two, 4-0 at Monza and 2-0 at home to Bologna. Roma to win at -286 or shorter is not a bet. The under is more interesting: Cagliari rarely score, Roma rarely concede, and BetRivers is offering plus money on under 2.5. The risk is Roma scoring three on their own, as they did in Naples. The pick: Under 2.5 goals at +114 at BetRivers. Marcus Thuram has five goals and Lautaro Martínez four. Venezia are last with three points, but their only win came against Napoli on Oct. 17; they then lost 1-0 at Genoa. Inter at -333 is too short to bet. Venezia have scored six goals all season, so a four-goal game would need Inter to do almost everything. Only LetsBetMD has posted a full price on this game among the US books compared. The pick: Under 3.5 goals at -111 at LetsBetMD. Venezia Vs Inter Odds Market LetsBetMD Venezia win +725 Draw +445 Inter win -333 Over O 3.5 -122 Under U 3.5 -111 AC Milan Vs Bologna Wednesday, Oct. 28, 1:30 p.m. ET, San Siro Milan are 5-3-0 with 18 points after beating Atalanta 3-2 and winning 2-0 at Udinese; Adrien Rabiot has four goals and three assists. Bologna are 2-2-4, have scored only eight goals and lost 3-1 at home to Inter before winning 2-0 at Cagliari. Milan are in form and at home, and Bologna's attack has been one of the weakest in the league. BetRivers has the best Milan price. A Bologna draw is the main risk, but the gap in quality is wide. The pick: AC Milan to win at -164 at BetRivers. Parma have scored five goals, the fewest in Serie A, and lost 3-0 at home to Torino and 2-1 at Lazio. Udinese have lost their last two at home, 3-0 to Lecce and 2-0 to Milan. Udinese are favored, but it is hard to see why on current form. Two struggling teams, one of which hardly scores, is a good setting for a draw, and LetsBetMD has the best price on it. This is one for small stakes. The pick: Draw at +220 at LetsBetMD. Monza are 2-1-5, but they beat Cagliari 4-0 and scored twice at Torino; Gustavo Varela has seven goals, tied for the league lead. Monza have also conceded 18. Napoli are favored, but their defense has not been reliable, and Monza have both scored and conceded freely. The over is the bet, even if BetRivers' -135 is short. Statistics Genoa Vs Juventus Wednesday, Oct. 28, 3:45 p.m. ET, Stadio Luigi Ferraris Juventus are 4-2-2 but have scored only 11 goals. They lost 3-0 at home to Lazio before winning 2-0 at Lecce. Genoa are 2-1-5 and have scored six goals, but they beat Venezia 1-0 on Sunday. Juventus are the better side, but -145 to -161 does not leave much value for a team that does not score many. The under is the more reliable angle with two low-scoring attacks. BetRivers has under 2.5, and LetsBetMD has under 2.25 at a better price. The pick: Under 2.5 goals at -137 at BetRivers. They drew 4-4 at Atalanta on Sunday. Lecce are 3-0-5; they won 3-0 at Udinese and then lost 2-0 at home to Juventus. Frosinone have been one of the surprises of the season, and they are a good price at home against a Lecce team that has scored nine goals. The concern is Frosinone's defense, which has conceded 13. BetRivers has the best price on the home win. The pick: Frosinone to win at -133 at BetRivers. They lost 3-1 at home to Como and 2-1 at Inter. Atalanta are 3-1-4 but have scored 14 goals, drew 4-4 with Frosinone and lost 3-2 at Milan; Nikola Krstović has six goals. This is the most surprising price of the round. A Fiorentina team at the bottom of the table and conceding more than two goals per game is the favorite. Atalanta have the better attack, and I would take them at +200 without hesitation. The pick: Atalanta to win at +200 at BetRivers or FanDuel.
